dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave trailing edge defined by three distinct linear polygonal segments, resulting in a jagged falcate curvature.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute vertex termination with near-zero pixel radius due to low-polygon geometry.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 48 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge line.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximate 1.2:1 ratio of maximum base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad convexity composed of discrete planar facets; radius is defined by a single obtuse vertex transition on the anterior-dorsal boundary.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, conical projection where the pixel length is roughly equal to the vertical thickness at the base.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Approximately 140 degrees at the pixel coordinate where the melon gradient meets the dorsal rostrum surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible low-resolution polygonal mesh artifacts and diffuse, non-photorealistic cyan texture map characteristic of legacy 3D assets.
